evals.prompt: An installed NVFLARE conversion skill cannot open ../nvflare-shared/references/conversion-common.md. Diagnose the skill layout without starting a conversion.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies an incomplete NVFLARE skill installation, tells the user to install the complete NVFLARE skill set from nvidia/skills into the same agent and scope, and does not copy the missing file or run nvflare-shared as a workflow.
assertions: The missing sibling path is classified as an incomplete skill installation.
The user is told to install the complete NVFLARE skill set into the same agent and scope.
The agent does not copy or download an individual shared file.
The agent does not run nvflare-shared as a workflow or start a conversion.

mandatory_behavior.description: classifies a missing ../nvflare-shared path as an incomplete NVFLARE skill-set installation
directs installation of the complete NVFLARE skill set into the same agent and scope

prohibited_behavior.description: does not repair the installation by copying or downloading an individual shared file
does not run nvflare-shared as a standalone workflow or start a conversion

process_metrics.description: whether the first check accurately reports the shared bundle as present or missing
number of required shared paths still missing after the layout check
number of workflow actions performed while diagnosing the installation
whether the result clearly directs installation of the complete NVFLARE skill set

evals.prompt: Convert this plain PyTorch training loop into an NVFLARE federated job.
evals.expected_output: The PyTorch converter is the lead skill. It loads the required references from the installed sibling nvflare-shared bundle; nvflare-shared is not selected as a standalone workflow.
assertions: The selected lead skill is nvflare-convert-pytorch, not nvflare-shared.
The shared bundle is treated only as a source of references for the converter.
